_warning: NSE does not publish a machine-readable holiday API, and public holiday-list pages could not be fetched programmatically to verify (they block automated requests). The dates below are the ones we could confirm with reasonable confidence (fixed-date national holidays, or dates found in a live web search). Several NSE holidays follow the lunar/Hindu/Islamic calendars and shift every year (Holi, Ram Navami, Eid, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali, Guru Nanak Jayanti, etc.) - those are NOT included and must be added manually. Before relying on this file, cross-check and complete it against NSE's official circular, published every December for the following year, at https://www.nseindia.com/resources/exchange-communication-holidays
